title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

trophies.name: Hero of Time
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.

trophies.name: A Cut Above
trophies.description: Obtain the Kokiri Sword from the training hole.

trophies.name: Root of the Problem
trophies.description: Defeat Gohma and break the curse afflicting the Great Deku Tree.

trophies.name: Green with Envy
trophies.description: Receive the Kokiri's Emerald.

trophies.name: Princess Pen Pal
trophies.description: Meet Princess Zelda in the castle courtyard.

trophies.name: Dodongo Dislikes Smoke
trophies.description: Defeat King Dodongo in Dodongo's Cavern.

trophies.name: Blood Brother
trophies.description: Receive the Goron's Ruby from Darunia.

trophies.name: Belly of the Beast
trophies.description: Defeat Barinade inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly.

trophies.name: Engagement Ring
trophies.description: Receive Zora's Sapphire from Princess Ruto.

trophies.name: Three of a Kind
trophies.description: Collect all three Spiritual Stones.

trophies.name: Catch of the Day
trophies.description: Catch the Ocarina of Time as Zelda flees Hyrule Castle.

trophies.name: The Blade of Evil's Bane
trophies.description: Draw the Master Sword from its pedestal in the Temple of Time.

trophies.name: Seven Years Later
trophies.description: Awaken as an adult after the Master Sword seals you away.

trophies.name: Ride Like the Wind
trophies.description: Win Epona from Ingo and leap the ranch fence to freedom.

trophies.name: Phantom Menace
trophies.description: Defeat Phantom Ganon and awaken Saria as the Forest Sage.

trophies.name: Into the Fire
trophies.description: Defeat Volvagia and awaken Darunia as the Fire Sage.

trophies.name: Fighting Your Shadow
trophies.description: Defeat Dark Link in the Water Temple.

trophies.name: Water Under the Bridge
trophies.description: Defeat Morpha and awaken Ruto as the Water Sage.

trophies.name: Afraid of the Dark
trophies.description: Defeat Bongo Bongo and awaken Impa as the Shadow Sage.

trophies.name: Sands of Time
trophies.description: Defeat Twinrova and awaken Nabooru as the Spirit Sage.

trophies.name: The Six Sages
trophies.description: Collect all six Medallions.

trophies.name: Seeing Is Believing
trophies.description: Obtain the Lens of Truth from the bottom of the well.

trophies.name: Big Trouble
trophies.description: Complete the adult trading quest and claim Biggoron's Sword.

trophies.name: Trial and Error
trophies.description: Clear all six trials in Ganon's Castle.

trophies.name: The Evil King
trophies.description: Defeat Ganondorf atop his crumbling castle.

trophies.name: Beast of Burden
trophies.description: Defeat Ganon and seal him away with the Sages' help.

trophies.name: Play It Again
trophies.description: Learn your first ocarina song.

trophies.name: Making It Rain
trophies.description: Learn the Song of Storms from the windmill man.

trophies.name: Fast Travel
trophies.description: Learn all six warp songs taught by Sheik.

trophies.name: Full Repertoire
trophies.description: Learn every ocarina song, including the Scarecrow's Song.

trophies.name: Seed of Doubt
trophies.description: Obtain the Fairy Slingshot.

trophies.name: Come Here Often?
trophies.description: Obtain the Hookshot from Dampé's grave.

trophies.name: Right on Target
trophies.description: Obtain the Fairy Bow in the Forest Temple.

trophies.name: Hammer Time
trophies.description: Obtain the Megaton Hammer in the Fire Temple.

trophies.name: Bottle Service
trophies.description: Carry four bottles at once.

trophies.name: Elemental
trophies.description: Obtain both the Fire Arrow and the Ice Arrow.

trophies.name: Fairy Godmother
trophies.description: Receive a magic upgrade from a Great Fairy.

trophies.name: Bigger Bang
trophies.description: Upgrade the Bomb Bag to its largest size.

trophies.name: Arachnophobia
trophies.description: Destroy your first Gold Skulltula.

trophies.name: House Cleaning
trophies.description: Destroy 50 Gold Skulltulas.

trophies.name: Spider's Web
trophies.description: Destroy all 100 Gold Skulltulas and lift the curse on the cursed family.

trophies.name: Have a Heart
trophies.description: Collect your first Piece of Heart.

trophies.name: Whole Hearted
trophies.description: Collect all 36 Pieces of Heart in Hyrule.

trophies.name: Ghostbuster
trophies.description: Sell 10 Big Poes to the Ghost Shop for the Giant's Wallet.

trophies.name: Jack and the Beanstalk
trophies.description: Plant all ten Magic Beans across Hyrule.

trophies.name: Tough Love
trophies.description: Earn the Double Defense upgrade from a Great Fairy.

trophies.name: Catch and Release
trophies.description: Reel in a fish at the Fishing Pond.

trophies.name: Mounted Marksman
trophies.description: Score 1,000 points at the Gerudo horseback archery range.

trophies.name: Grave Danger
trophies.description: Beat Dampé's ghost in a race through his grave.

trophies.name: Right Up the Alley
trophies.description: Win a prize at the Bombchu Bowling Alley.

trophies.name: Pierre the Scarecrow
trophies.description: Teach Bonooru the Scarecrow a song of your own.

trophies.name: Sun's Song Serenade
trophies.description: Freeze a ReDead in place by playing the Sun's Song.
